Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body:
The Bitter and Sweet Story
Event.

Each Methuselah gets +2 hand size for each victory point he or she has.

1.what happen if you oust controler of The Bitter and Sweet Story? can you draw 2 cards and discard them immediately,or you dont get time for draw cards?

2.what if in same time with political action need to oust you prey and crosstable(controlor of The Bitter and Sweet Story) and you want to save you cross with Life boon,do you need to play Life bonn before draw 2 cards or after? ofc,if you play political action that not be in you turn(Enkil Cog),or you predator playing political action-so i mean to you can play Out-of-turn master.

Life Boon
Out-of-turn. Boon.

Give pool to a Methuselah with no pool to keep them in the game, and put this card in play. During each of their unlock phases, you can steal 1 pool from that Methuselah. You gain any victory point gained by that Methuselah instead of them, until you are being ousted or until you have gained 1 victory point from this card. Burn this card after you have gained 1 victory point from this card.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> beslin wrote:
> The Bitter and Sweet Story
> Event.
>
> Each Methuselah gets +2 hand size for each victory point he or she has.
>
> 1.what happen if you oust controler of The Bitter and Sweet Story? can you draw 2 cards and discard them immediately,or you dont get time for draw cards?
>
You don't draw. There is no situation where, at the same time, your prey is ousted and the Bitter and Sweet Story is in play.

> beslin wrote:
> 2.what if in same time with political action need to oust you prey and crosstable(controlor of The Bitter and Sweet Story) and you want to save you cross with Life boon,do you need to play Life bonn before draw 2 cards or after?
>
Before drawing. The ousts are simultaneous.
